tasks.short: Monitor publications for patches and viruses

steps.what: Run the existing monitor of industry sites
List stored titles about patches, releases, and viruses
Read publications for information on those titles
Make the potential problem identification from the titles

tasks.design: The specialist monitors industry sites or publications for information about patches, releases, viruses, or potential problem identification. The existing feed in {DATA_PLATFORM} already runs, and that runtime is not the specialist's time. A list shows stored titles only. A blank title stays blank. No patch is applied. The identification stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist read sites and publications and then identified the problem.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored titles can be listed. The feed already runs. Identifying the problem stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying a potential problem stays with the specialist. A patch is not applied here.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does not treat a blank title as a virus.
tasks.altitude: The feed's runtime is not new labour. The identification stays at full effort. No patch is applied.

reach.task: Hear which problem the specialist identified

evidence.claim: Stored advisory titles can be listed. Identifying a potential problem stays manual, and a patch is not applied.

assumptions: The work starts with a period and ends when the specialist has identified a problem or stopped. No patch is applied.
An advisory title has title, source, and date, entered by the specialist when they capture one. The existing feed's runtime is not the specialist's time. A blank title is left blank.
The list does not identify the problem and does not apply a patch.
unknowns: Which sources the specialist is expected to read.
research_questions: How often was a title blank, so the specialist went back to the publication?

already_counted.description: Making the problem identification is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a title the specialist has rechecked.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: titles are often blank, so the identification is unchanged. High: titles are listed, the specialist still reads the publications, and the identification stays theirs. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Create technical documentation for network installations
Update technical documentation for changes to existing installations
Review the technical documentation before it is stored

tasks.design: The specialist creates or updates technical documentation for network installations or changes to existing installations. The writing stays at full effort. {DOCS} does not generate the text. It stores only the version the specialist has accepted. A blank change description stays blank and stops the store.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist wrote the technical note and filed it by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted note can be stored. The technical text stays the specialist's.
tasks.still_hard: Writing what the installation or the change did stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a note that describes a change they did not make.
tasks.altitude: The documentation is stored only after the specialist accepts that version. The text is not generated.

evidence.claim: An accepted technical note can be stored. Writing the documentation stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with an installation or a change and ends when the accepted documentation is stored, or the specialist stops.
A note has installation identifier, change description, and date, written by the specialist. A blank change description is left blank and is not invented.
The store uses the documentation accepted in the review.
unknowns: Which installations must have technical documentation before they are left running.
research_questions: How often did a blank change description stop the store?

already_counted.description: Creating the technical documentation is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a change description before the documentation is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: change descriptions are often blank, so the specialist still writes the note. High: the note is complete, the specialist reviews it, and only the accepted documentation is stored. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Train users in procedures related to network applications
Train users in procedures for related software systems

tasks.design: The specialist trains users in procedures related to network applications software or related systems. The training stays at full effort. Nobody is scored. Nothing in {LMS} delivers the training.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist trains the users in person.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching the procedure stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist stops when the procedure is not the one the users were sent to learn.
tasks.altitude: The training stays at full effort. Users are not scored.

reach.task: Send the users who asked for the procedure
reach.learn: Which procedures were the wrong ones.

evidence.claim: Training users in network procedures stays in person. Users are not scored.

assumptions: The work starts with users and a procedure and ends when the specialist has trained them, or stops.
No score is stored. Upkeep is zero.
A later written procedure, if one is kept, is a different task.
unknowns: Which procedures the specialist trains, and which a colleague trains.
research_questions: How often did the specialist stop because the procedure was the wrong one?

already_counted.description: Training users in network applications is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the training adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every training session is still given by the specialist. High: the same training remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Test repaired items for proper operation

steps.what: Test repaired items to ensure proper operation
Confirm repaired items still ensure proper operation

tasks.design: The specialist tests repaired items to ensure proper operation. The test stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} passes the item.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist tests the repaired item and confirms it operates.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored script passes the item.
tasks.still_hard: Judging proper operation stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does not pass an item that failed the test.
tasks.altitude: The test stays at full effort. Nothing in it is shortened.

evidence.claim: Testing repaired items for proper operation stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a repaired item and ends when the specialist has tested it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Returning the item to the user is a different task.
unknowns: Which operation the test must show before an item is returned.
research_questions: How often did the specialist refuse to pass an item that failed the test?

already_counted.description: Testing repaired items is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the test adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every repaired item is still tested by the specialist. High: the same test remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still decides access, diagnoses a fault, and signs a change. A permission list, report, or document is written or published only after the specialist accepts that version.
reach: An operations lead receives only a network report the specialist has accepted.
A service desk colleague receives only a request record the specialist has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required counter, field, or resolution is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep diagnosis, access decisions, and physical work in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every monthly network report traces to a stored counter, and the specialist still signs the exception.
